title: Foxpro To MySQL Migration Tool
text: A tool to migrate Foxpro DBF files to MySQL database.
description: A WPF .NET C# application that reads Foxpro DBF files and migrates the data to a MySQL database. It supports batch processing of multiple DBF files, data type mapping, and error handling. The tool provides a user-friendly interface for selecting source files, configuring database connections, and monitoring migration progress.
highlights: Dual embedding providers: ML.NET TF-IDF (local, fast) and ONNX Runtime (neural networks)
384-dimensional vector embeddings with cosine similarity ranking
Customizable training data via training-data.json for domain-specific optimization
Auto-seeding with 22 diverse documents (Marvel movies, family films, tech concepts)
Modern responsive UI with Bootstrap 5 and real-time database status
Diagnostic endpoints for embedding testing, database status, and reseeding
Clean architecture with dependency injection and provider pattern
Production-ready with configurable providers via appsettings.json
coreFeatures: Reads Foxpro DBF files and extracts data
Maps Foxpro data types to MySQL data types
Supports batch processing of multiple DBF files
Has stop and resume releasedity
Displays migration progress and error handling

title: Country Law Repo API

title: Semantic Search Web Api
description: A .NET 8 Web API demonstrating semantic search using vector embeddings. Supports ML.NET TF-IDF (local, default) and ONNX Runtime for neural network models. Search using natural language - e.g., 'billionaire superhero' finds Iron Man. Converts text into 384-dimensional vectors and uses cosine similarity for ranking. Features configurable providers, customizable training data, auto-seeding with sample documents, diagnostic endpoints, and a Bootstrap frontend.
highlights: Dual embedding providers: ML.NET TF-IDF (local, fast) and ONNX Runtime (neural networks)
384-dimensional vector embeddings with cosine similarity ranking
Customizable training data via training-data.json for domain-specific optimization
Auto-seeding with 22 diverse documents (Marvel movies, family films, tech concepts)
Modern responsive UI with Bootstrap 5 and real-time database status
Diagnostic endpoints for embedding testing, database status, and reseeding
Clean architecture with dependency injection and provider pattern
Production-ready with configurable providers via appsettings.json
coreFeatures: Understands meaning and intent, not just keywords
Uses embeddings/vectors to measure semantic similarity
Retrieves contextually relevant results even with different wording
Supports hybrid search (semantic + keyword)
Can rerank results using AI models for higher relevance
